sheets.title: A · 강화복형 · 2.2m
sheets.detail: Concept A: 2.20m total armored standing height, direct wearable powered exosuit. Standing 1.70m human is 77.3% of mech height in hero scale comparison. Keep armor family, slightly lengthen limbs enough to contain a human and keep shoulders bulky. SIDE SECTION: human stands fully upright; human head INSIDE mech helmet, upper arms inside expanded upper-arm shells, forearms inside forearm shells, shins inside mech shins, feet in lifted armored boots. Machine and human joint axes line up; the 0.5m height gain comes from sole lift, helmet clearance and armor, NOT a tiny person hidden in torso. Suit finger actuator reinforces user's hand; backpack battery and ankle boost pistons. Back shell opens as clamshell with leg/forearm armor spread; pilot steps backwards into suit, closes plates. Show forearm cross-section human hand inside mechanized glove and knee aligned to user's knee. Advantage communicated: human agility and tight interiors; limitation: incoming impact acts near body. TEXT EXACT: "A · 강화복형", "전고 2.2m", "사람 1.7m", "직접 착용", "관절 정렬", "후면 개방", "발목 보조", "착용 → 동작 추종 → 베기".

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one polished landscape CHARACTER DESIGN AND OPERATING MECHANISM CONCEPT SHEET for the HEX BLADE player mech. Reference image 1 is the user's selected mech identity and illustration style reference, NOT a screenshot to reproduce. Isolate and faithfully develop the main cream robot design: ivory/cream beveled industrial armor, wide faceted rounded shoulder armor, compact helmet with central raised forehead ridge and narrow orange glowing chevron visor, dark graphite exposed mechanical joints, olive/brass small hardware, cyan back power units, chunky gauntlets and boots, red glowing straight blade. Preserve its friendly heavy industrial cleaner/swordsman identity and proportions as appropriate for the proposed scale. No Gundam V-fin, no generic superhero armor, no menu UI, no companion drone.
Style: professional hand-painted anime game concept art, precise dark violet outlines, crisp planar cel shading, subtle pencil construction and paper grain, warm off-white technical sheet with subdued lilac grid, graphite dimension arrows, restrained mint callout accents; reference quality, no photorealism.
Layout: generous readable landscape sheet about 3:2; left 45% full-body three-quarter hero in a neutral upright stance with lowered red sword; center 22% smaller front and rear orthographic views; right 33% LARGE colored side-section anatomy showing the whole pilot at plausible scale inside machine, hatch-open boarding vignette, and a knee/arm mechanism detail. Every view has consistent armor and joints. Distinguish solid exterior from translucent cutaway. Pilot is the same adult human 1.70m tall in simple charcoal fitted coveralls, shown in warm coral inside cutaway, no erotic or decorative character art. Human must fit plausibly without clipping. Include precise-looking height dimension from soles to helmet top beside hero, a separate standing 1.70m human on SAME ground baseline as hero, correctly proportioned to specified machine height; height excludes sword and backpack. Human scale is crucial. Technical callouts communicate concept rather than claiming engineering validation. Large Korean title, sparse Korean labels, height numerals legible. All short text spelled as specified, no filler paragraph or tiny illegible text. Operational arrows show forces, linkages and boarding direction. Bottom clean ribbon with three little clearly sequential action silhouettes for boarding/control/attack. Do not make every design simply the same body enlarged: cockpit type and joint construction must visibly explain size.

sheets.title: B · 동작 추종형 · 3.6m
sheets.detail: Concept B: 3.60m standing heavy motion-tracking frame, the midpoint between wearable suit and a seated cockpit mech. Standing 1.70m human is 47.2% of mech height beside hero. Preserve original squat strong mech silhouette with a relatively large helmet, broad cream shoulders and short heavy armored shins. SIDE CUTAWAY: a FULL-SIZE 1.70m human upright in a small central back-entry motion cradle with torso/head entirely inside mech upper torso, NOT inside mech helmet. Human hips in mech pelvis. Human legs descend into upper thighs and END in foot stirrups within robot's upper-thigh cavities ABOVE the mech knee joints. Mech lower legs and ankles contain ONLY actuators, zero pilot limbs. Human elbows bent, hands on small independent tracking grips inside chest near ribs, never stretch human arms into giant robot forearms. Clear mint motion-arrow linkage from pilot grips to distant robot arms and stirrups to hydraulic legs. Human torso is suspension isolated by harness. Rear shell hatch swings out; mech kneels to lower rear entry step, pilot enters BACK directly into standing cradle; no front seat. Detail: thigh foot cradle sends leg intent to extended motorized lower leg, visible pivot and shock piston. Helmet is separate sensor head. TEXT EXACT: "B · 동작 추종형", "전고 3.6m", "사람 1.7m", "기립식 조종", "동작 증폭", "발판은 허벅지 안", "센서 헤드", "후면 탑승", "탑승 → 동작 증폭 → 강타".

sheets.title: C · 탑승형 · 6m
sheets.detail: Concept C: 6.0m tall compact PILOTED ROBOT with a seated chest cockpit. Standing 1.70m human is 28.3% of mech standing height beside hero. Faithful cream squat bulky mech with large visor helmet, reinforced large shoulders, independent arms and large feet; recognizable as the reference rather than entirely new design. SIDE CUTAWAY: FULL-SIZE adult 1.70m human SEATED in suspension seat, knees bent and feet at cockpit pedals entirely INSIDE CHEST AND UPPER ABDOMEN capsule; head well below independent sensor helmet. Cockpit is only compact central capsule, arms and legs pure motors. Hands on two short joysticks, panoramic internal display arc, four-point harness, isolated shock mounts. Chest front plate hinges upward as boarding canopy; machine kneels, person uses retracting two-stage ladder from floor to chest hatch. Clear callouts include seat capsule, separated external sensor head, electric-hydraulic knee and recoil damper. Detail of foot's powered toe articulation and leg load-bearing cylinder. Motion arrows show control signal to remote joint actuator, not one-to-one body alignment. Bottom sequence kneeling entry -> joystick pilot -> wide heavy slash. TEXT EXACT: "C · 탑승형", "전고 6m", "사람 1.7m", "흉부 조종석", "좌석·페달 조종", "독립 구동 관절", "전면 해치", "탑승 → 조작 → 중량 베기".

sheets.title: D · 거대형 · 18m
sheets.detail: Concept D: 18.0m GIANT piloted industrial sword mech. Standing 1.70m human is only 9.44% of mech standing height beside hero. Preserve reference design identity and squat heavy body, orange visor, cream chunky shell, graphite joints and red industrial blade. Make large-scale construction evident: layered armor plate segments, ankle service doors, handrail near chest maintenance deck, broad telescoping hydraulic knee and multiple actuators per finger, small restrained warning bands. Do NOT clutter with arbitrary weapons. Hero full-body with sword lowered; small person at boot on SAME baseline makes giant scale unmistakable. RIGHT SIDE SECTION is an ENLARGED LOCAL CHEST COCKPIT DETAIL explicitly boxed "흉부 확대"; do not pretend a large pilot fills the entire 18m body's torso. In overall side-profile outline indicate small cockpit rectangle around sternum; connect to the enlarged detail with two thin dashed magnification leaders. Enlarged capsule shows adult 1.70m pilot in seat, joysticks, display arc, shock isolation, service corridor outside sealed capsule. Main machine arms/legs all independent actuators. Boarding vignette includes a narrow external SERVICE LIFT tower/deck carrying a human to chest hatch (clearly an access facility, not integral giant cockpit), another small silhouette at robot boot. Knee detail shows large pistons and maintenance ladder and tiny technician to establish scale. Bottom boarding-lift -> seated control -> slow massive ground sweep. TEXT EXACT: "D · 거대형", "전고 18m", "사람 1.7m", "흉부 확대", "흉부 캡슐", "정비 리프트", "다중 구동기", "탑승 → 조작 → 광역 베기".
